text: Ko Kanko woni fuɗɗorɗo tagugol ngol no ko aldah, e yeru gadiiɗo refti O ruttita ngu ɓaawo gaynugol fii maggu. Awa fuɗɗitagol ngol hino ɓuri fuɗɗagol ngol welde fii, fow mun, ɗin ɗiɗi kala hino newanii Alla; tawde si O faandanike huunde, O daalanay nde tun: "Laato", nde laatoo. Hino woodani Mo Kanko tedduɗo mawɗo On, sifa ɓurɗo toowude on e kala ko O sifortee e sifaaji mawngu e timmal. Ko Kanko woni Fooluɗo Mo fooletaak, Ñeeñuɗo e tagu Mun e toppitagol Mun.
